verdict.rationale: Mastra Code is a terminal coding agent with documented structure-aware AST editing and LSP diagnostics that report errors or warnings introduced by edits, which supports general code changes and fixing flagged issues. None of the four named tasks is explicitly documented. The `mastracode update` command updates the tool itself, not project dependencies, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented test-writing workflow, explicit lint-fix support, merge-conflict resolution, project dependency updating, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: Edit code using abstract syntax tree (AST) analysis for intelligent, structure-aware transformations.
Returns Language Server Protocol (LSP) diagnostics showing any errors or warnings introduced by the edit.
